heading: INT. MARRIOTT SUITES - 4TH FLOOR CORRIDOR - NIGHT

units.text: INT. MARRIOTT SUITES - 4TH FLOOR CORRIDOR - NIGHT
fluorescent light. carpet the colour of a bruise. a room service cart abandoned outside 412.
COREY, DANI, BEX, MARCUS and LENA stand in a loose knot outside the conference suite, lanyards still on, name tags crooked, the team retreat is in its third hour of "synergy".
ok but nobody says anything to Greg.
units.name: COREY

units.text: nobody's saying anything to Greg.
units.name: DANI

units.text: because last time somebody said something to Greg we all got a mindfulness seminar.
units.name: COREY

units.text: i liked the mindfulness seminar.
units.name: BEX

units.text: Bex, they made us hold hands with the interns.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: it was grounding. also i'm allowed to like things.
units.name: BEX

units.text: Bex is allowed to like things.
units.name: LENA

units.text: thank you Lena. they are the only one who gets it.
units.name: BEX

units.text: ON PHONE: A message from "GREG (VP)" lights up Corey's screen. "great energy team!! back in 5 for the breakout"
he said breakout. Dani. he said breakout.
units.name: COREY

units.text: no. no no no. we did the breakout.
units.name: DANI

units.text: that was the pre-breakout.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: what's the difference between a breakout and a pre-breakout
units.name: LENA

units.text: the pre-breakout has snacks.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: i'm not going back in. i'm going to stay in the hall and become a plant.
units.name: BEX

units.text: Bex you literally can't. you're presenting the deck.
units.name: DANI

units.text: Dani, they, i mean i, i have never once presented the deck. you're confusing me with the other Bex.
units.name: BEX

units.text: there's another Bex?
units.name: COREY

units.text: no. i just wanted to see if you'd check.
units.name: BEX

units.text: ON PHONE: A second message, group chat "RETREAT 2K24 (DO NOT MUTE)".
Lena: "dont look but greg is at the elevator".
Marcus: "he's crying???"
Dani: "happy crying or layoff crying"
They all turn at once.
At the far end of the corridor, the elevator dings.
GREG, 50s, vest, lanyard, a laminated agenda, steps out wiping his eyes with a tiny hotel napkin.
Layoff crying.
units.name: LENA

units.text: Happy crying doesn't wear a vest.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: Everybody act normal. Dani, normal.
units.name: COREY

units.text: i'm so normal. i am the normalest.
units.name: DANI

units.text: hi Greg.
units.name: BEX

units.text: Greg looks up.
A beat.
He sniffles.
Team. Great. Love it. Love the energy.
units.name: GREG

units.text: He walks past them into the suite and the door sighs shut.
They stand in the corridor in silence.
So. Breakout.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: Breakout.
units.name: COREY

units.text: They don't move.
The cart rattles faintly as the building settles.
